parent_tips.before_reading: Preview 'Mouse in the House' together. Ask: What do you think Mouse will do? Look for short vowel words like: mouse, house, out, loud, found.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child sound out tricky words. Notice the short vowel pattern in words like mouse, house, out, loud, found. Encourage expression when reading!
parent_tips.after_reading: Discuss: What happened when Mouse got into trouble? What happened at the end? What was your favorite part about the house?
